name: Craft Body Modification (Item Creation)
body:
You can craft magical body modifications.

Prerequisite(s): Caster level 3rd.

Benefit(s): You can create any magical body modification whose construction requirements you meet. Crafting a body modification takes 1 day for each 1,000 gp in its price. To create a body modification, you must use up raw materials costing half its base price.

You can also mend a broken body modification if it is one that you could make. Doing so costs half the raw materials and half the time it would take to craft that modification.

See the magic item creation rules for more information.
